content: check-jsonschema: CLI + pre-commit hooks over python-jsonschema; validates committed JSON/YAML against a local or remote schema via --schemafile. Pattern for data-contract tests: one hook per data-file-set/schema pair (files: ^data/.*\.json$, args: [--schemafile, schemas/foo.json]) plus --check-metaschema to validate schemas themselves. pre-commit run --all-files runs identically locally and in CI, giving a lightweight data-contract gate. pipx/brew installable.
